rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without her knowledge.

Orcs 
"We chase out humans, we have crushed Barbarians and soon you will be next!"

Orc  
"I smash you like the weak humans!"

Mage 
"Leave this place while you still live!"

Hill Giant 
"Long ago, the Humans ruled this region. With their fall from power the Barbarians and Orcs have waged war. We must becareful not to get caught in their battle or we will perish as the humans did before us."

Tempest Giant 
"The Orcs have murdered many Humans and Barbarians. Proceed with caution do not let them weaken our front line. Neither the Orcs, Humans nor Barbarians will defeat us."

Ashkael 
"Human bones are scattered across the land. Orcs and Barbarians are mighty foes. Be warned that you will need to heal your weak. Do not let these cretins wear you down. Bethrezen forgives failure!"

Duke  
""The battle rages on! Fight cowards and send your enemies to the fiery pits. Barbarians have been seen making their way! Be warned that this fight has only just begun."

Ghost 
"Master I sense that there are many Goblins and Orcs. They watch us now as I speak to you."

Ghost 
"I sense that we have disturbed an Orc rites of passage! The Orcs and Goblins will attack us, we must be prepared at all times."

Orc 
"Orc you must go or Orc will get mad!"

Hermit 
"Gather as much artifacts, banners and staffs. What we do not gather will surely fall into the hand's of our enemies. I fear what the Undead Hordes will do should they find the Holy Chalice!"

Wizard 
"Orcs are strong but the spiders will be here soon, they are dangerous."

Paladin 
"The land will eventually sink into the sea! An archaic prophecy reads that if the Barbarians are removed from the land that the sea shall claim the land! I have heard rumors that a barbarian tribe is making its way to turn the tide."

Orc 
"No one will defeat our Champion."

Orc 
"Orcs rule this land get out!"

Orc 
"We will crush your kind. Orcs fear nothing. You and the humans shall share the same fate. Death by our hands!"

Orc 
"Orcs destroy strangers! Orcs burn cities where strangers live!"
My savage Barbarians  will fight for your cause ... for the right price.

Squire 
"The Barbarians are mighty only a strong frontline will protect the weaker members of your party. Hopefully!"
My spells are the most potent in the region.

Cleric 
"In the name of the Highfather we shall oppose all those that try to claim this land. Your transgressions will not go unpunished!"
My items are the best in the realm.

Centaur 
"I cannot believe that this entire land mass is sinking to a watery grave. We must help these Barbarians, it is what Gallean would have us do. We must prevent the upcoming events. The Barbarians are terrified and that makes them dangerous!"

Scout 
"We have entered in the middle of an ongoing conflict. Our enemies are everywhere proceed with caution. I have heard that the prisons hold a number of useful items. We will conquer this land in the name of Gallean!"

Elf Ranger 
"A tribe of Barbarians are said to be on their way here. From what I have heard we have some time before they arrive. Just prepare yourselves. Once they arrive we will have an even deadlier battle on our hands!"

Abyssal Devil 
"The Barbarians will arrive! They will spread death and pain to all those that stand in their way!"

Archlich 
"The Barbarians will arrive! Their might is not to be underestimated. Mortis will be most displeased if her mighty servants fall to the loathsome Barbarian forces!"

Forge Guardian 
"There are many artifacts and banners that can aid us on our Quest. Be sure to use these items wisely. Wisdom will be our greatest asset."

Orc King 
"We will be avenged! An Orc Champion will appear. In time all shall fall to the wrath of our Champion!"

Orc Champion 
"Kill! Death and pain shall come! Death to those who have defeated my King!"
